description: A dynamic URL segment declared with a colon (`users/:id`). Its value is always a **string**.
Optional `?key=value` pairs after the path. Not part of route matching.
Router feature that binds path params, query params, route `data` and resolved values to component inputs with matching names.
Injectable describing the current route: `paramMap`, `queryParamMap`, `data` observables plus a `snapshot` with the values at creation time.
When only params change, the router keeps the same component instance. Code that reads `snapshot` once in the constructor misses the update.
Built-in input transform that converts strings such as `'42'` to numbers (`NaN` falls back to an optional default).
